span.p:
Human and computer symbols use the same visible reveal.
Computer search starts here, off the main thread.
Fast search must not shorten the reveal.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No fixed presentation timer.
Board remains locked until the decision is ready.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Board is already committed, including a terminal move.
Display Computer through AI_SETTLING even if
domain activePlayer has changed to the human.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Timed callbacks require GAME screen and matching presentationId.
Domain commit also requires matching revision and turn token.
Reduced Motion changes delays and decoration, not state order.
